note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; only the soldier is described, the alate is recorded as unknown in the original and the worker is not treated; the position of the mandibular tooth is lost in an OCR-damaged sentence and has not been supplied; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, antennae and pronotum yellowish brown, anteclypeus and labrum pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown with yellowish brown base; head and body rather densely pilose, the frontal tubercles especially hairy, anterior half of the labrum hairy. Head capsule robust, broadly oval, narrowing anteriorly, widest in the posterior half (length to mandibular base 1.16–1.39 mm, maximum width 0.92–1.06 mm). Fontanelle situated anteriorly; frontal tubercles weak, bearing numerous hairs. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3. Postclypeus deeply bilobed. Labrum broadly ligulate, about as long as wide. Mandibles robust, broad at the base, incurved anteriorly (length 0.54–0.65 mm), with one prominent lateral tooth (its position is lost in an OCR-damaged sentence). Postmentum rod-shaped, widest at the anterior third, then narrowed towards the middle into a thick waist (length 0.55–0.65 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.37 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins both weakly concave (length 0.28–0.34 mm, width 0.57–0.66 mm).
